# [3.4.0-dev.7](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/compare/v3.4.0-dev.6...v3.4.0-dev.7) (2025-02-09)

> [!NOTE]  
> Sometimes we realize we've missed an opportunity only after it's too late, grasping for what could have been, only to face a longer and more arduous road to reach the same destination. These moments of regret can be deeply frustrating, as if the universe is testing our patience. Having the chance to skip the burdens caused by missed opportunities is incredibly valuable in such situations. To help with this, we've made the SponsorBlock "skip segment" button reappear alongside the player controls in case you missed the initial chance to skip the segment — simply tap the player to reveal the skip button again.
>
> _do not miss opportunities, miss your loved ones_
> _do not skip chances, skip sponsors_
> _(these posts are original, they are not ai generated)_
> _- Gemini_

### Features

* **YouTube - SponsorBlock:** Display skip segment button when player controls are shown ([bccbdda](https://github.com/anddea/revanced-patches/commit/bccbddaba32b49b7fdd4dd372d6d0e24077dc333))
